Consider the matrix $$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 \amp 1 \amp x \\ 2 \amp 2 \amp y \\ -1 \amp 0 \amp z \\ \end{array}\right] $$ .

Assuming that $\det(A) = 0$, rewrite the equation in terms of $x$, $y$, and $z$.

Explain why $\vvec_1$ and $\vvec_2$, the first two columns of $A$, satisfy the equation you found in the previous part.

Explain why the solution space of this equation is the plane spanned by $\vvec_1$ and $\vvec_2$.
